# Nehemiah Chapter 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 473r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NEH_012_page_001.jpg

---

**12:1** And-these [are] the-priests and-the-Levi'im who-went-up [she-alu] with Zerubbavel son of-She'alti'el and-Yeshua: Serayah, Yirmeyah, Ezra, **12:2** Amaryah, Mallukh, Chattush, **12:3** Shekhanyah, Rechum, Meremot, **12:4** Iddo, Ginneton, Aviyyah, **12:5** Miyyamin, Ma'adyah, Bilgah, **12:6** Shemayah, and-Yoyariv, Yedayah, **12:7** Sallu, Amoq, Chilqiyyah, Yedayah. These [were] the-heads of-the-priests and-their-brothers in-the-days of-Yeshua.

**12:8** And-the-Levi'im: Yeshua, Binnuy, Qadmi'el, Sherevyah, Yehudah, Mattanyah — over the-thanksgivings [al ha-hodot], he and-his-brothers. **12:9** And-Baqbuqyah and-Unni, their-brothers, [were] opposite-them [le-negdam] in-watches [le-mishmarot].

**12:10** And-Yeshua fathered [holid] Yoyaqim, and-Yoyaqim fathered Elyashiv, and-Elyashiv fathered Yoyada, **12:11** and-Yoyada fathered Yonatan, and-Yonatan fathered Yaddua.

**12:12** And-in-the-days of-Yoyaqim were priests, heads of-fathers: of-Serayah, Merayah; of-Yirmeyah, Chananyah; **12:13** of-Ezra, Meshullam; of-Amaryah, Yehochanan; **12:14** of-Mallukhi, Yonatan; of-Shevanyah, Yosef; **12:15** of-Charim, Adna; of-Merayot, Chelqay; **12:16** of-Iddo, Zekharyah; of-Ginneton, Meshullam; **12:17** of-Aviyyah, Zikhri; of-Minyamin, of-Mo'adyah, Piltay; **12:18** of-Bilgah, Shammua; of-Shemayah, Yehonatan; **12:19** of-Yoyariv, Mattenay; of-Yedayah, Uzzi; **12:20** of-Sallay, Qallay; of-Amoq, Ever; **12:21** of-Chilqiyyah, Chashavyah; of-Yedayah, Netan'el.

**12:22** The-Levi'im in-the-days of-Elyashiv, Yoyada, and-Yochanan, and-Yaddua were-recorded [khetuvim] heads of-fathers, and-the-priests, until [ad] the-reign [malkhut] of-Daryavesh the-Parsi [ha-Parsi].

**12:23** The-sons of-Levi, heads of-fathers, were-written in-the-book of-the-chronicles [sefer divrey ha-yamim], unto the-days of-Yochanan son of-Elyashiv.

**12:24** And-the-heads of-the-Levi'im: Chashavyah, Sherevyah, and-Yeshua son of-Qadmi'el, and-their-brothers opposite-them [le-negdam] to-praise [le-hallel] and-to-give-thanks [le-hodot] by-the-commandment of-David the-man of-God [ish ha-Elohim], watch [mishmar] corresponding-to [le-ummat] watch.

**12:25** Mattanyah, and-Baqbuqyah, Ovadyah, Meshullam, Talmon, Aqqub, gatekeepers [sho'arim] keeping-watch [shomerim] at-the-storehouses [ba-asuppey] of-the-gates.

**12:26** These [were] in-the-days of-Yoyaqim son of-Yeshua son of-Yotsadaq, and-in-the-days of-Nechemyah the-governor [ha-pechah] and-Ezra the-priest, the-scribe [ha-sofer].

**12:27** And-at-the-dedication [chanukat] of-the-wall [chomat] of-Yerushalayim they-sought [biqqeshu] the-Levi'im from-all their-places [mi-kol meqomotam] to-bring-them to-Yerushalayim, to-make the-dedication [la-asot chanukkat] with-joy [be-simchah] and-with-thanksgivings [u-ve-todot] and-with-song [u-ve-shir], cymbals [metsiltayim], lyres [nevalim], and-harps [ve-khinnorot].

**12:28** And-the-sons of-the-singers [benei ha-meshorerim] gathered together, and-from the-circuit [ha-kikkar] around Yerushalayim, and-from the-villages of-the-Netofati [chatserey Netofati],

**12:29** and-from Beyt ha-Gilgal and-from the-fields [sadot] of-Geva and-Azmavet, for villages [chatserim] the-singers had-built for-themselves around Yerushalayim.

**12:30** And-the-priests and-the-Levi'im purified-themselves [va-yittaharu], and-they-purified the-people and-the-gates and-the-wall.

**12:31** And-I-brought-up [va-a'aleh] the-leaders [sarey] of-Yehudah upon the-wall, and-I-appointed two great thanksgiving-processions [todot gedolot] and-processions [ve-tahlukhot]. [The first went] to-the-right [la-yamin] upon the-wall toward the-Dung Gate [Sha'ar ha-Ashpot].

**12:32** And-went after-them Hoshayah and-half the-leaders of-Yehudah, **12:33** and-Azaryah, Ezra, and-Meshullam, **12:34** Yehudah, and-Binyamin, and-Shemayah, and-Yirmeyah.

**12:35** And-from the-sons of-the-priests with-trumpets [ba-chatsotsrot]: Zekharyah son of-Yonatan son of-Shemayah son of-Mattanyah son of-Mikhayah son of-Zakkur son of-Asaf,

**12:36** and-his-brothers Shemayah and-Azar'el, Millay, Gilalay, Ma'ay, Netan'el, and-Yehudah, Chanani, with-the-instruments [bi-khley shir] of-David the-man of-God, and-Ezra the-scribe before-them [lifneyhem].

**12:37** And-at the-Fountain Gate [Sha'ar ha-Ayin] and-straight-ahead [ve-negdam] they-went-up on-the-steps of-the-City of-David [Ir David], at-the-ascent of-the-wall, above the-house of-David, and-unto the-Water Gate to-the-east.

**12:38** And-the-second thanksgiving-procession [todah] went to-the-left [le-mol], and-I after-it, and-half the-people upon the-wall, above the-Tower of-the-Ovens [Migdal ha-Tannurim] and-unto the-Broad Wall [ha-Chomah ha-Rechavah],

**12:39** and-above the-Gate of-Efrayim [Sha'ar Efrayim] and-above the-Yeshanah Gate [Sha'ar ha-Yeshanah] and-above the-Fish Gate [Sha'ar ha-Dagim] and-the-Tower of-Chanan'el and-the-Tower of-the-Hundred [Migdal ha-Me'ah] and-unto the-Sheep Gate [Sha'ar ha-Tson]; and-they-stood in-the-Gate of-the-Guard [Sha'ar ha-Mattarah].

**12:40** And-the-two thanksgiving-processions stood in-the-house of-God [beyt ha-Elohim], and-I and-half the-officials [ha-seganim] with-me,

**12:41** and-the-priests Elyaqim, Ma'aseyah, Minyamin, Mikhayah, Elyo'enay, Zekharyah, Chananyah, with-trumpets [ba-chatsotsrot],

**12:42** and-Ma'aseyah and-Shemayah and-El'azar and-Uzzi and-Yehochanan and-Malkiyyah and-Eilam and-Ezer. And-the-singers [ha-meshorerim] sang-loudly [va-yashmi'u] and-Yizrachyah [was] the-overseer [ha-paqid].

**12:43** And-they-offered [va-yizbechu] on-that day great sacrifices [zevachim gedolim] and-rejoiced [va-yismechu], for God caused-them-to-rejoice [simecham] with-great joy [simchah gedolah]; and-also the-women [ha-nashim] and-the-children [ha-yeladim] rejoiced, and-the-joy [simchat] of-Yerushalayim was-heard from-far-away [me-rachoq].

**12:44** And-were-appointed on-that day men over the-chambers [ha-leshakhot] for-the-storehouses [la-otsarot], for-the-contributions [la-terumot], for-the-firstfruits [la-reshit], and-for-the-tithes [la-ma'asrot], to-gather into-them according-to-the-fields [sadey] of-the-cities the-portions [menot] of-the-Torah for-the-priests and-for-the-Levi'im; for the-joy [simchat] of-Yehudah [was] over the-priests and-over the-Levi'im who-stood [ha-omedim].

**12:45** And-they-kept [va-yishmeru] the-charge [mishmeret] of-their-God and-the-charge of-the-purification [ha-taharah], and-the-singers and-the-gatekeepers, according-to-the-commandment of-David and-Shelomoh his-son.

**12:46** For in-the-days of-David and-Asaf of-old [mi-qedem] there-were heads [rashey] of-the-singers and-songs of-praise [shir tehillah] and-thanksgivings [hodot] to-God.

**12:47** And-all Yisra'el in-the-days of-Zerubbavel and-in-the-days of-Nechemyah gave the-portions [menot] of-the-singers and-the-gatekeepers, the-need of-each-day [dvar yom be-yomo], and-they-set-apart [maqdishshim] for-the-Levi'im, and-the-Levi'im set-apart for-the-sons of-Aharon.

---

## EMET's Textual Notes
1. **12:27 "dedication" (chanukkat)** — The Hebrew root *ch-n-k* later gives its name to the festival of Hanukkah; here it refers to the consecration ceremony for the newly rebuilt wall.
2. **12:31 "two great thanksgiving-processions"** — The processions walked in opposite directions atop the wall and met at the Temple, symbolically encircling the city with praise.
3. **12:36 "instruments of David"** — The musical instruments are attributed to David's institution, connecting post-exilic worship directly to the monarchy's liturgical traditions.
4. **12:43 "the joy of Jerusalem was heard from far away"** — A climactic statement that reverses the desolation of 1:3; the ruined city now radiates joy that reaches the surrounding nations.

*— EMET*
